prestiges.name: 死水元帅
prestiges.tooltip: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">优点</s><n/>生物战斗单位的生命值提高100%。<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">缺点</s><n/>矿骡不可用。
prestiges.tooltip_en: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">Advantage</s><n/>Biological combat units gain 100% increased life.<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">Disadvantage</s><n/>MULEs are unavailable.

prestiges.name: 狂暴骑手
prestiges.tooltip: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">优点</s><n/>后燃推进系统会额外使攻击速度提高100%。冷却时间缩短50%。<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">缺点</s><n/>单位的消耗不再减少。后燃推进系统消耗10点生命值并且移动速度加成减少到50%。
prestiges.tooltip_en: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">Advantage</s><n/>Ignite Afterburners additionally increases attack speed by 100%. Cooldown reduced by 50%.<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">Disadvantage</s><n/>Units no longer cost less. Ignite Afterburners costs 10 life and its movement speed bonus is reduced to 50%.

prestiges.name: 起义军游骑兵
prestiges.tooltip: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">优点</s><n/>星港、军械库和轨道控制基地不再有科技需求。星港不再消耗高能瓦斯，并且其中的单位所消耗的高能瓦斯降低30%。维京战机、女妖和战列巡航舰每使用一份补给，就会使顶部技能条的冷却速率加快1%。<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">缺点</s><n/>战斗单位消耗的晶体矿提高50%。
prestiges.tooltip_en: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">Advantage</s><n/>The Starport, Armory, and Orbital Command no longer have tech requirements. The Starport no longer has a gas cost and its units cost 30% less gas. Vikings, Banshees, and Battlecruisers increase top bar cooldown rates by 1% per supply used.<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">Disadvantage</s><n/>Combat units cost 50% more minerals.

prestiges.name: 恶毒族长
prestiges.tooltip: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">优点</s><n/>恶变菌毯的效果提高100%。虫后不再被减速并且可以在恶变菌毯之外放置菌毯肿瘤。<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">缺点</s><n/>虫道网络和虫道网络欧米茄不可用。
prestiges.tooltip_en: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">Advantage</s><n/>Malignant Creep effectiveness increased by 100%. Queens are no longer slowed and may place Creep Tumors while off creep.<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">Disadvantage</s><n/>Nydus and Omega Networks are unavailable.

prestiges.name: 人类的愚行
prestiges.tooltip: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">优点</s><n/>凯瑞甘在使用跳击和灵能位移时会消耗狂怒的层数，对附近的敌人造成50点伤害，并使其昏迷3秒。<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">缺点</s><n/>凯瑞甘的变异甲壳生成量降低50%。凯瑞甘的技能伤害降低50%。
prestiges.tooltip_en: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">Advantage</s><n/>Kerrigan expends stacks of Fury while using Leaping Strike or Psionic Shift, striking nearby enemies for 50 damage and stunning them for 3 seconds.<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">Disadvantage</s><n/>Kerrigan's Carapace generation reduced by 50%. Kerrigan's ability damage reduced by 50%.

prestiges.name: 荒寂女王
prestiges.tooltip: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">优点</s><n/>吸收光环资源掉落提高100%。凯瑞甘获得动能冲击和粉碎勒握。<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">缺点</s><n/>跳击和灵能位移不可用。
prestiges.tooltip_en: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">Advantage</s><n/>Assimilation Aura resource drops increased by 100%. Kerrigan gains Kinetic Blast and Crushing Grip.<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">Disadvantage</s><n/>Leaping Strike and Psionic Shift are unavailable.

masteries.name: 主要技能伤害和攻击速度

prestiges.name: 勇敢激励者
prestiges.tooltip: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">优点</s><n/>所有激活的战斗单位技能效果提高100%。<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">缺点</s><n/>战斗单位消耗的资源提高30%。
prestiges.tooltip_en: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">Advantage</s><n/>Increase the effectiveness of all active combat unit abilities by 100%.<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">Disadvantage</s><n/>Combat units cost 30% more.

prestiges.name: 星灵使节
prestiges.tooltip: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">优点</s><n/>使用时，投射能量场将你的战斗单位从一个已经存在的力场投射器中折跃出来，并将他们折跃到新的位置。移除冷却时间。<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">缺点</s><n/>投射能量场消耗25能量。
prestiges.tooltip_en: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">Advantage</s><n/>Upon use, Project Power Field warps out any of your combat units standing in an existing Power Field projection into the new location. Cooldown removed.<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">Disadvantage</s><n/>Project Power Field costs 25 energy.

prestiges.name: 方舟指挥官
prestiges.tooltip: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">优点</s><n/>轨道轰炸折跃一个无拘狂热者，释放出破坏性能量，持续15秒。护盾超载可以对目标施放，冷却时间缩短50%，消耗25能量。<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">缺点</s><n/>轨道轰炸消耗50能量。守护之壳无法使用。
prestiges.tooltip_en: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">Advantage</s><n/>Orbital Strikes warp in an Unbound Fanatic that throws off damaging energy and lasts 15 seconds. Shield Overcharge is now targeted, has its cooldown reduced by 50%, and costs 25 energy.<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">Disadvantage</s><n/>Orbital Strike costs 50 energy. Guardian Shell is disabled.

masteries.name: 护盾超载持续时间与强度
能量回复速度与冷却时间缩减
折跃的单位获得初始急速
亚顿之矛初始和最大能量

prestiges.name: 重武器专家
prestiges.tooltip: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">优点</s><n/>激光钻机可以造成100%的溅射伤害，使目标减速70%，并且锁定目标的速度加快50%。<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">缺点</s><n/>激光钻机的技能不可用。
prestiges.tooltip_en: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">Advantage</s><n/>The Laser Drill deals 100% splash damage, slows movement speed by 70%, and locks on targets 50% faster.<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">Disadvantage</s><n/>The Laser Drill's abilities are unavailable.

prestiges.name: 机械修理工
prestiges.tooltip: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">优点</s><n/>炮塔升级效果提高100%。<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">缺点</s><n/>战斗单位消耗的高能瓦斯提高50%。
prestiges.tooltip_en: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">Advantage</s><n/>Turret upgrades are 100% more effective.<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">Disadvantage</s><n/>Combat units cost 50% more vespene gas.

prestiges.name: 运载总监
prestiges.tooltip: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">优点</s><n/>大力神拥有两倍的装载容量并且可以立即卸载单位。科学船可以使用战术跳跃并且冷却时间缩短50%。<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">缺点</s><n/>顶部技能条的冷却时间增加50%。
prestiges.tooltip_en: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">Advantage</s><n/>Hercules have twice the cargo capacity and unload units instantly. Science Vessels can use Tactical Jump and its cooldown reduced by 50%.<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">Disadvantage</s><n/>Top bar cooldowns increased by 50%.

masteries.name: 汇聚射线的伤害和宽度
战斗空投的持续时间和生命值
永生程序的消耗与用时
激光钻机建造时间、升级时间以及升级费用

prestiges.name: 爆蚊虫后
prestiges.tooltip: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">优点</s><n/>最大补给上限提高50。孵化跳虫和爆蚊时，每个虫卵可以额外孵化一个单位。爆虫巢穴可以额外孵化4个免费的爆虫，爆蚊巢穴可以额外孵化4个免费的爆蚊。<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">缺点</s><n/>扎加拉不可用。
prestiges.tooltip_en: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">Advantage</s><n/>Max supply increased by 50. Zerglings and Scourge spawn one extra unit per egg. Baneling Nests will spawn an additional 4 free Banelings and Scourge Nests will spawn 4 free Scourge.<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">Disadvantage</s><n/>Zagara is unavailable.

prestiges.name: 构造体之母
prestiges.tooltip: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">优点</s><n/>畸变体和腐化者的消耗降低25%，生命值提高50%，并且生命值恢复速度大幅提高。<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">缺点</s><n/>没有免费的爆虫。
prestiges.tooltip_en: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">Advantage</s><n/>Aberrations and Corruptors cost 25% less, gain 50% increased health, and possess greatly increased health regeneration.<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">Disadvantage</s><n/>No free Banelings.

prestiges.name: 顶级掠食者
prestiges.tooltip: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">优点</s><n/>扎加拉的技能冷却时间缩短，生命值和能量回复速度提高，并且可以进入深槽虫道。<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">缺点</s><n/>群体狂暴只能影响扎加拉和她召唤的单位。战斗单位的消耗提高25%。
prestiges.tooltip_en: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">Advantage</s><n/>Zagara gains reduced ability cooldowns, increased health and energy regeneration, and access to the Deep Tunnel ability.<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">Disadvantage</s><n/>Mass Frenzy only affects Zagara and her summoned units. Combat units cost 25% more.

masteries.name: 生命值和能量回复速度
空投蟑螂伤害和生命值

prestiges.name: 精神休憩
prestiges.tooltip: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">优点</s><n/>紧急召回会将隐形单位召回到最近的星灵枢纽或黑暗水晶塔，而不是基础建筑，并完全恢复生命值和护盾。部署黑暗水晶塔的冷却时间和资源消耗减少50%。<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">缺点</s><n/>黑暗水晶塔失去召回技能。
prestiges.tooltip_en: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">Advantage</s><n/>Emergency Recall recalls cloaked units to the closest Nexus or Dark Pylon instead of the primary structure and heals life and shields to full. Deploy Dark Pylon cooldown and cost reduced by 50%.<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">Disadvantage</s><n/>Dark Pylons lose Recall.

prestiges.name: 凋零虹吸
prestiges.tooltip: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">优点</s><n/>虚空静滞、神经错乱、静滞结界、干扰网和黑暗缠绕可以影响英雄单位，并且使敌人每秒损失20生命值。该效果无法致死。<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">缺点</s><n/>战斗单位造成的伤害降低25%。静滞结界的持续时间缩短75%。
prestiges.tooltip_en: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">Advantage</s><n/>Void Stasis, Confusion, Stasis Ward, Disruption Web, and Darkcoil may affect heroic units and cause enemies to lose 20 life per second. This effect cannot kill.<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">Disadvantage</s><n/>Combat units deal 25% reduced damage. Stasis Ward duration reduced by 75%.

prestiges.name: 暗影守护者
prestiges.tooltip: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">优点</s><n/>时间停止可以对目标施放。所有已死亡的暗影卫队将会在目标所在地点复活。<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">缺点</s><n/>暗影卫队的持续时间缩短40%。
prestiges.tooltip_en: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">Advantage</s><n/>Time Stop becomes targeted. All Shadow Guard who have died are resurrected at the target location.<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">Disadvantage</s><n/>Shadow Guard duration reduced by 40%.

masteries.name: 亚顿之矛初始和最大能量

prestiges.name: 战争建筑师
prestiges.tooltip: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">优点</s><n/>重构光束的效率提高了100%，并且可以瞄准的建筑翻倍。统和屏障影响建筑，并且冷却时间缩短75%。时空提速、时空波动和提速力场会影响防御建筑并增加它们的攻击频率。	<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">缺点</s><n/>重构光束只能瞄准建筑物。统和屏障不再影响单位。
prestiges.tooltip_en: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">Advantage</s><n/>Repair Beam is 100% more effective and can target twice as many structures. Unity Barrier affects structures and its cooldown is reduced by 75%. Chrono Boost, Chrono Wave, and Chrono Field affect defensive structures, increasing their rate of attack.	<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">Disadvantage</s><n/>Repair Beam may only target structures. Unity Barrier no longer affects units.

prestiges.name: 圣堂表象
prestiges.tooltip: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">优点</s><n/>战斗单位的消耗减少40%。<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">缺点</s><n/>光子炮台和凯达琳巨石不可用。
prestiges.tooltip_en: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">Advantage</s><n/>Combat unit cost reduced by 40%.<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">Disadvantage</s><n/>Photon Cannons and Khaydarin Monoliths are unavailable.

prestiges.name: 天界太阳能
prestiges.tooltip: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">优点</s><n/>轨道轰炸和太阳能射线枪消耗的能量降低40%。太阳能射线枪和净化光束的冷却时间缩短50%。<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">缺点</s><n/>时空提速、时空波动和提速力场不可用。
prestiges.tooltip_en: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">Advantage</s><n/>Orbital Strike and Solar Lance energy cost reduced by 40%. Solar Lance and Purifier Beam cooldowns reduced by 50%.<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">Disadvantage</s><n/>Chrono Boost, Chrono Wave, and Chrono Field are unavailable.

masteries.name: 战斗单位的生命值与护盾
亚顿之矛的能量回复速度在超级提速期间加快（净 +1能量，持续20秒）
亚顿之矛初始和最大能量

prestiges.name: 精华贮藏者
prestiges.tooltip: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">优点</s><n/>战斗单位可以额外持有25层生物质，并且在死亡时有额外50%的几率掉落他们的生物质。<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">缺点</s><n/>终极进化不可用。
prestiges.tooltip_en: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">Advantage</s><n/>Combat units can hold an additional 25 Biomass and have an additional 50% chance to drop their Biomass upon death.<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">Disadvantage</s><n/>Ultimate Evolutions are unavailable.

prestiges.name: 深隧惊惧
prestiges.tooltip: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">优点</s><n/>蝗虫的攻击射程、移动速度和持续时间提高50%。深槽虫道的升级不再需要主巢，不再需要视野，并且蟑螂和破坏者可以使用。	<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">缺点</s><n/>战斗单位增加25%的高能瓦斯消耗。
prestiges.tooltip_en: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">Advantage</s><n/>Locusts have 50% increased attack range, movement speed, and duration. The Deep Tunnel upgrade no longer requires Hive, no longer requires vision, and can be used by Roaches and Ravagers.	<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">Disadvantage</s><n/>Combat units cost 25% more vespene gas.

prestiges.name: 无限进化
prestiges.tooltip: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">优点</s><n/>终极进化的数量不再限制为3个。<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">缺点</s><n/>终极进化需要200层生物质。生物质的效果变弱了。
prestiges.tooltip_en: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">Advantage</s><n/>The number of Ultimate Evolutions is no longer limited to 3.<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">Disadvantage</s><n/>Ultimate Evolution requires 200 Biomass. Biomass is less powerful.

masteries.name: 剧毒巢穴最大充能数和冷却时间

prestiges.name: 灵魂巧匠
prestiges.tooltip: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">优点</s><n/>当一名死徒死亡时，会增加阿拉纳克身边其中一个非英雄机械战斗单位的伤害和攻击速度。<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">缺点</s><n/>致命冲锋和湮灭波的伤害降低50%。
prestiges.tooltip_en: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">Advantage</s><n/>When a Supplicant dies, it increases the damage and attack speed of one of Alarak's nearby non-heroic mechanical combat units.<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">Disadvantage</s><n/>Deadly Charge and Destruction Wave damage reduced by 50%.

prestiges.name: 暴君晋升者
prestiges.tooltip: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">优点</s><n/>供奉我的冷却时间缩短50%。<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">缺点</s><n/>死亡舰队不可用。
prestiges.tooltip_en: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">Advantage</s><n/>Empower Me cooldown reduced by 50%.<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">Disadvantage</s><n/>The Death Fleet is unavailable.

prestiges.name: 死亡阴影
prestiges.tooltip: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">优点</s><n/>召唤死亡舰队永久持续并且没有初始冷却时间。母舰可以建造毁灭者。<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">缺点</s><n/>召唤死亡舰队时不再召唤毁灭者。母舰和毁灭者现在消耗资源和补给。群体传送现在有60秒的冷却时间并且不再能够传送友方单位。
prestiges.tooltip_en: <s val="Coop_Prestige_Advantage">Advantage</s><n/>Summon Death Fleet has no duration or initial cooldown. The Mothership may construct Destroyers.<n/><n/><s val="Coop_Prestige_Disadvantage">Disadvantage</s><n/>Destroyers are no longer summoned with the Mothership. The Mothership and Destroyers have resource and supply costs. Mass Teleport now has a 60 second cooldown and no longer teleports allied units.

masteries.name: 阿拉纳克自动攻击伤害
供奉我奴仆们持续时间
死亡舰队冷却时间缩短
建筑超载额外护盾与伤害

prestiges.name: 雇佣兵
